description:
The Allegro team is united by a clear purpose—advancing technologies that make the world safer, more efficient, and more sustainable. With over 30 years of experience in semiconductor innovation, we bring that purpose to life across every part of the business—from breakthrough product development and customer success to how we show up for each other and the communities we serve.
 
 
 The Opportunity 
 
Robotics – and particularly the rapidly accelerating humanoid market – is an essential growth vector for Allegro MicroSystems. As a Systems Engineer, Robotics within our Industrial Business Segment (IBS) Corporate Strategy Team, you will have a direct impact on strengthening Allegro's position in this exciting new frontier.
In this role, you will sit at the intersection of hands-on engineering and strategic marketing. You will be a creative technical force that evaluates our newest Sensing and Power products and brings them to life through compelling, real-world robotics demonstrations. We are offering a tremendous opportunity for a passionate mechatronics engineer to help shape the future of robotics at Allegro.
 
 What You Will Do 
 
 Robotics Prototyping & Demo Development 
 Act as a creative mind of the team by conceptualizing, designing, and building meaningful robotics demonstrations (e.g., humanoid joint actuators, dexterous hands) that showcase Allegro’s capabilities.

 Apply your hands-on mechatronics expertise to integrate Allegro's motor drivers, magnetic sensors, and power management ICs into functional robotic sub-systems.

 
 Technical Evaluation & Lab Analysis 
 Execute hardware evaluation. Calibration, and debugging on innovative new sensing and power products.

 Benchmark system-level performance (e.g., control loop latency, torque estimation, sensor accuracy) to ensure our solutions meet the demands of modern robotics and humanoid applications.

 
 Cross-Functional Collaboration & Marketing Support 
 Partner closely with Marketing, Product Line teams, and external stakeholders to translate complex lab data into high-impact technical marketing collateral.

 Serve as a collaborative team player and technical subject matter expert, bridging the gap between R&D, product strategy, and customer-facing demonstrations.

 
 What You Will Bring 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.

 Familiarity with robotic control systems, kinematics, motion planning, and AI/ML-enabled systems.

 Hardware and mechatronics: foundation in circuit design, component selection, PCB layout and debug workflows, and electromechanical systems (sensors/actuators).

 Embedded and programming: familiarity with microcontrollers and experience in C and Python for testing and integration.

 Entry-level to 5 years of professional experience in robotics, mechatronics, or electronics engineering.

 A deep, demonstrable passion for the robotics industry, with a keen interest in the evolving humanoid landscape.

 Creative Problem Solver: you love brainstorming out-of-the-box ideas for new products and ways to demonstrate technology.

 Exceptional Communicator: you can distil highly technical lab results into clear, compelling stories and marketing materials.

 Collaborative Team Player: you thrive in highly interactive environments and build strong relationships with both internal teams and external partners.

 Technical growth: you are willing to stay current with developments in robotics, embedded systems, and engineering tools.

 
 This role will be located in Manchester NH USA, Annecy, France, or Milano, Italy.
 #LI-Hybrid
 
 
 
 
 Why Allegro? 
  
 Join Allegro and become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.
 We foster a culture of Real Innovation , empowering you to push boundaries, develop cutting-edge solutions, and drive continuous improvement.
Your work will create a Real Impact by solving complex real-world challenges that fuel our success and shape the future of technology.
You’ll experience Real Connection , collaborating with talented colleagues around the globe in an environment built on trust, respect, and a shared purpose.
 Join us—and help build what’s next. 
 
 
 At Allegro, we are committed to providing a harassment-free environment of mutual respect to fuel innovation through inclusive thought collaboration.  Allegro is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, parental status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.  Allegro makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time. 
 
 

 
 Eligible applicants must reside in a state where Allegro currently has an office location: This includes New Hampshire, Massachusetts, Texas, and Michigan. Certain positions (such as field sales roles) may be exempt from this requirement.
